title: Balloon
description: This mod adds a balloon for adventure.
body:
# Mod Info

## Mod Item List
- Balloons
- Night Vision Goggles

## Balloons
- For floating
- Crafted with 1 leather and 1 string

## > How to use
- Sit on ground recharge and/or repair automatically
- Right Click to float
- Sneak Right Click to float forwards
- While using elytra you can Right Click to accelerate

## Night Vision Goggles
- For seeing in the dark
- Crafted with 2 redstone, 4 sticks, and 2 glass blocks

## > How to use
- Gives Night Vision every tick when equipped
